notes.title: Bus Driving Sim 22 - Update Version 1.3
notes.content:
Bus Driving Sim 22 update version 1.3 includes the following improvements/fixes/enhancements:

- Added school bus with a new driving scenario
- Added japanese language
- Added the possibility to change buses color (except for the school bus)
- Improved performance on day transitions
- Improved audio quality
- Assorted bug fixes

notes.title: Bus Driving Sim 22 - Update Version 1.2
notes.content:
Bus Driving Sim 22 update version 1.2 includes the following improvements/fixes/enhancements:

- Added MacOS support (minimum 10.13 - macOS High Sierra)
- Most available steering wheel controller models should be supported now
- Added TrackIR support
- Added mouse steering
- Added individual camera view buttons
- Added a new sports car in cities's traffic
- Added realistic thunders to the heavy rain weather
- Added bus kneeling in stations
- Improved UI navigation for keyboard, gamepad and steering wheel navigation
- Added speedometer and tachometer support for modded buses including updated custom bus as provided for template
- Fixed hard braking penalty not deducting total XP
- Improved speed limitation on Bavaria (30 km/h on dirt road, 50km/h on normal, 90 km/h on highway)
- Added the possibility to activate or deactivate camera movement when steering in gameplay settings
- Fixed central mirror that sometimes got frozen
- Reduced volume of the destination voice on exterior camera
- Improved collision for one traffic car
- Set the default zoom in interior camera to be more zoomed out

notes.title: Bus Driving Sim 22 - Update Version 1.1
notes.content:
Bus Driving Sim 22 update version 1.1 includes the following improvements/fixes/features: 

- Added new electric bus that unlocks at 10.000 XP
- Improved overall performance, especially for Munich and Los Angeles night time
- Improved overall lighting together with day and night cycle
- Added respawn button in pause menu
- Added adjustable music volume in audio settings
- Added reverse camera when driving with interior view
- Higher speed for traffic cars on highways
- Adjusted XP thresholds for unlocking the buses
- Fixed XP earned on multiplayer not adding to the total XP
- Added the option for random selection of weather and time
- Added visibility option for UI interior tachometer in gameplay settings
- Fixed some prop vehicles like ambulances, firetrucks etc. that were previously mismatched with country-specific maps
- Added Steam profile avatar near the player's username when playing in multiplayer
- Improved passenger seating position in buses
- Some stickers on the buses have been reduced in size so they do not intrude with the view
- On California and Los Angeles, buses no longer get stuck on the improvised bridges when stopping their wheels between plates
- Disabled a mandatory blinker check on last station of route 5 Bavaria
- Selected route in main menu is more visible
- Improved current shadows on the buses and also added shadows to the doors
- Weather and time of day synchronizes on multiplayer after finishing the first selected route
- Time no longer freezes when going to pause menu on multiplayer
-  Fixed issue with gear in automatic mode that would not decrease when driving at high speed and then hitting something
- Added adjustable brightness in the graphics settings panel
- Removed faulty TXAA antialiasing option
- Fixed gameplay time not being updated properly in main menu stats panel
- Fixed the doors message popup not disappearing after opening them
- Fixed AI traffic car wheels not having shadows
- Fixed main menu theme being played twice sometimes
- Fixed fake shadow conflict with real-time shadow beneath the bus
- Improved cruise control when stopping the input acceleration so the speed no longer decreases instantly when going at cruise speed
- Added new game logo in tutorial panel
- Fixed man walking dog path on Los Angeles Route 5
- Improved road reflections during rainy weather
- Removed road artefacts on Brazil
- Adjusted volume on some background noises like birds, wolves etc.
- Added error message when trying to create a room with duplicate name in multiplayer
